component.name: HandCue
component.summary: Control your computer with gestures from your webcam
Controla el ordenador con gestos desde la webcam

description.p: HandCue recognizes hand, face and body gestures with your webcam and turns them into actions: media keys, apps, websites, keyboard shortcuts, typing, a virtual mouse, photos and more. Everything runs locally.

ul.li: Over 35 gestures, each with its own hold time and cooldown
Face recognition with groups, and an option to only obey registered people
Webcam controls (exposure, white balance, focus, zoom and framing) with profiles
Virtual camera with background blur, color or image for Meet, Zoom or OBS
Pauses itself when the privacy shutter is closed
